MBTP.description: Member Type (MBTP). The member's design classification, driven solely by the TYPE enum. Key = element number (the element must exist). To use any /DESIGN/STEEL/AIJ-ASD02/* endpoint, first activate the AIJ-ASD02 design code with PUT /TEMP/DESIGN/STEEL/AIJ-ASD02/DCO. DELETE removes the member-type assignment from the element.

TYPE.description: Member type classification (case-insensitive). One of COLUMN, BEAM, BRACE.
